scope: Local Linux validation only. Remote CI is independently attached to the published commit.
limitations: Google verifier tests use real signatures on synthetic tokens and local callback failure boundaries; no real Google project, Google account authorization exchange or account linking was performed.
SMTP uses a real loopback fixture and synthetic email addresses; no production mail provider or real inbox delivery was tested.

Chromium virtual USB/platform CTAP2 authenticators exercise real WebAuthn signatures, user verification and backup flags. Physical hardware, mobile cross-device flows and cloud account synchronization were not tested.
Scenario counts include repetitions across database/cache modes and are not counts of distinct product requirements.
Local tests do not establish native desktop installers, Windows plugin named pipes, macOS signing, screen-reader accessibility, long-load behavior or optimized release performance.
Four-language SDK and native OS core checks are separately executed by GitHub Actions; old receipts are not reused as current CI proof.
